problem.decision_or_job: Prioritize in-transit shipments for timely coordinator review before their promised arrival
problem.trigger: eligible shipment receives a carrier-status update
problem.current_state: Coordinators manually scan a time-ordered queue and combine carrier status with local judgment
pain_evidence: Illustrative teaching scenario; validate observed review delays and exception patterns with dispatch coordinators

functional_requirement.decision: Decide whether an eligible shipment needs a coordinator review now
functional_requirement.action: Create a non-binding review case only when deterministic policy requires coordinator attention
functional_requirement.accepted_outcome: Coordinator accepts or rejects a correctly routed review case with current evidence

scope.initial_segment: in-transit shipments promised to arrive within 72 hours and carrying current carrier signals

outcome.accepted_event: Coordinator accepts or rejects a correctly routed review case with current evidence
outcome.verifier: Dispatch review record links the case to current shipment evidence and a coordinator disposition

eligible_population.definition: Single-tenant in-transit shipments within 72 hours of promise time and with complete current signals
eligible_population.denominator_event: eligible shipment status update enters the triage workflow
exclusions: shipments already in a manual escalation

baseline.source: teaching placeholder; replace with observed coordinator-routing sample

value_case.attribution_method: Illustrative pilot compares an eligible shadow cohort with coordinator-accepted routing and reconciles downstream delivery outcomes

workflow.evidence: Illustrative review sequence and exception boundaries are documented; validate with dispatch observation

context.evidence: Shipment and carrier evidence contracts are defined, but production freshness coverage is unmeasured

verifier.evidence: Coordinator disposition can verify route acceptance; intervention outcomes need agreed reconciliation

integration.evidence: Reference contracts cover reads and review-case creation only

adoption.evidence: No coordinator usability study is included in the local reference

operations.evidence: Service-review design is documented but no deployed service is operated

risk.evidence: No autonomous shipment action and representative routing failures are executable

constraints: Do not use the placeholder economics or score threshold for a customer decision

stop_conditions: Any route uses stale, missing, or cross-tenant evidence
Coordinator review burden or cost per accepted decision exceeds the charter ceiling
Calibration, adoption, or support evidence is insufficient for the selected segment

decision.rationale: The reference demonstrates bounded hybrid routing but cannot establish customer value, calibrated model performance, or operating readiness

assumptions.statement: Current carrier signals can be attributed to the correct tenant and shipment
assumptions.validation_method: Compare a pilot signal sample with shipment-system records

assumptions.statement: Dispatch coordinators can act on a review case before its promised arrival time
assumptions.validation_method: Observe queue latency and coordinator disposition during shadow operation
